title: Hosted machine verdict
statement: Let $F$ be a machine format, let $\alpha,x,z$ be finite bit strings, and let $d$ be a configuration of the step-block machine for the machine denoted by decoding $\alpha$, on input $x$. Suppose $d$ is at the live entry state and correctly represents that decoded machine's initial configuration together with its transition table and summary tapes. For every $t\in\mathbb N$ and every input-head position $p$ among the $|z|+2$ positions, the hosted verdict machine, started with $d$, a counter encoding $t$, and input-head position $p$, halts after some $T$ steps with $T\le t\bigl(50(|L|+1)+4\bigr)+2\ell(t)+3$, where $L$ is the serialized transition table and $\ell(t)$ is the length of the binary expansion of $t$. Its output is $d$'s output followed by a bit $a$, and $a=1$ if and only if the decoded machine halts on $x$ within $t$ steps with output exactly $[1]$.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is at the live entry state
$d$ correctly represents the decoded machine's initial configuration and associated tapes
$p$ is one of the $|z|+2$ input-head positions
